meta.title: People's Republic of China rules that govern moving money out of China
meta.columnPolicy: Values appear only where the linked official source states them. Anything not confirmed is the literal string "unverified" and is repeated on the Flagged for Review page.

rules.topic: Individual foreign-exchange facilitation quota
rules.finding: The annual quota for individual foreign-exchange purchases was raised from USD 20,000 to USD 50,000. An annual quota of USD 50,000 also applies to individual foreign-exchange sales, for both domestic and foreign individuals.
rules.value: USD 50,000 equivalent per individual per year

rules.topic: Treatment of amounts above the quota
rules.finding: Formalities and vouchers for foreign-exchange sales and purchases within the quota are drastically simplified; examination of the authenticity of transactions exceeding the quota is strengthened.
rules.value: Documented authenticity review above USD 50,000

rules.topic: Bank monitoring of individual FX purchases and sales
rules.finding: SAFE established a management information system connecting banks with SAFE for individual sales and purchases of foreign exchange. Via this system banks deal with the business and verify the authenticity of the materials provided by individuals. The stated purpose includes preventing acts of avoiding administration such as repeated purchases and sales in installments.
rules.value: Bank-to-SAFE system verifies authenticity of every individual FX purchase and sale

rules.topic: Individual foreign-exchange settlement account for trade
rules.finding: Individual trade businessmen and private businessmen may open foreign-exchange settlement accounts, administered as institutional accounts. Purchases and sales of foreign exchange under those accounts are NOT subject to the annual quota limits and are conducted with valid trading documents regardless of amount.
rules.value: No annual quota for genuine individual trade

rules.topic: Transfers between an individual's own FX savings accounts
rules.finding: Capital transfers for individual foreign-exchange savings accounts may be conducted only between accounts of the same nature held by the individual or his or her direct relatives, and transfers of capital-account foreign-exchange items are subject to examination and verification.
rules.value: Same-nature accounts only; individual or direct relatives

rules.topic: Overseas cash withdrawal cap with a domestic bank card
rules.finding: In overseas cash withdrawals by individuals with domestic bank cards, the sum of withdrawals using cards in the individual's own name, including supplementary cards, shall not exceed the equivalent of RMB 100,000 in every civil year.
rules.value: RMB 100,000 equivalent per individual per civil year
rules.authority: SAFE Circular Huifa No. 29 [2017], effective 1 January 2018

rules.topic: Overseas cash withdrawal daily cap
rules.finding: The ceiling for overseas cash withdrawals per foreign-currency card per day was adjusted from the equivalent of USD 1,000 to the equivalent of RMB 10,000; the RMB card continues to be subject to a ceiling of the equivalent of RMB 10,000 per card per day.
rules.value: RMB 10,000 equivalent per card per day

rules.topic: Consequence of exceeding the overseas withdrawal quota
rules.finding: In case of overseas cash withdrawals in excess of the annual quota, the individuals will not be allowed to withdraw cash overseas with the domestic bank cards in the current and second years. SAFE circulates a daily list of suspended individuals to card issuers.
rules.value: Suspended for the current year and the following year

rules.topic: Card borrowing and lending to evade the cap
rules.finding: Individuals are prohibited from borrowing others' bank cards or lending their bank cards to evade or help evade the management of overseas cash withdrawals.
rules.value: Expressly prohibited

rules.topic: Relationship between the card cap and the USD 50,000 quota
rules.finding: SAFE states the overseas card cash-withdrawal regime does not contradict the annual quota of USD 50,000 for foreign-exchange purchases by individuals, does not affect normal cash withdrawals or consumption, and does not reduce convenience.
rules.value: Two independent limits

rules.topic: Categories of lawful personal asset outbound transfer
rules.finding: Outbound transfer of personal assets as defined in the Rules includes emigrant asset transfer and inheritor asset transfer, and the Rules do not apply to other forms of personal asset transfer.
rules.value: Two categories only

rules.topic: Definition of emigrant asset transfer
rules.finding: Emigrant asset transfer refers to encashment, exchange at a commercial bank and transfer overseas of assets by emigrants from Mainland China which they obtained before they obtained immigration permission from a foreign country or from Hong Kong or Macao SARs.
rules.value: Assets obtained BEFORE the immigration status was obtained

rules.topic: Definition of inheritor asset transfer
rules.finding: Inheritor asset transfer refers to encashment, exchange at a commercial bank and transfer overseas of assets by foreign citizens and residents of Hong Kong or Macao SARs.
rules.value: Foreign citizens and HK/Macao permanent residents only

rules.topic: Where the application is filed
rules.finding: Applications for emigrant asset transfer are filed to the local SAFE branch where the emigrant originally registered their residence; applications for inheritor asset transfer are filed to the local SAFE office where the person whose assets are inherited originally registered their residence. Local sub-branches may accept applications, and an applicant may act through an entrusted person.
rules.value: SAFE branch at the original registered residence

rules.topic: Lawfulness condition on transferred assets
rules.finding: Assets applied for transfer are limited to lawful assets belonging to the applicant and indisputable as to ownership. SAFE does not accept applications for assets prohibited from transfer by judicial or supervisory authorities, for assets that are legally untransferable, for assets with no proof of lawful source, or for assets involved in unsettled criminal or civil litigation.
rules.value: Lawful, owned, undisputed and documented

rules.topic: Remittance mechanics under the personal-asset rules
rules.finding: Designated banks remit the foreign exchange directly to the account opened by the applicant in the country or region of emigration or settlement. Drawing foreign-exchange cash within the territory of Mainland China is not allowed under these rules.
rules.value: Direct remittance to the overseas account; no domestic cash drawing

rules.topic: Penalty for false documents in a personal-asset transfer application
rules.finding: An applicant found swindling foreign exchange with false documents, or filing applications for asset transfer based on the same assets, is penalized by SAFE in line with the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Foreign Exchange Administration.
rules.value: Penalty under the PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations

rules.topic: 2014 simplification of immigration and inheritance property transfers
rules.finding: The requirement that an immigrant's property be transferred several times was cancelled; after approval the bank may remit the funds in a lump sum or in several batches within the limit specified in the approval document. The requirement that property transfers above RMB 500,000 equivalent be reported to SAFE for the record was cancelled. Property inherited from different decedents may now be applied for in a combined application.
rules.value: Lump-sum remittance permitted within the approved limit
rules.authority: SAFE circular of 1 August 2014 on capital account policies

rules.topic: Chinese individual income tax — who is a resident
rules.finding: An individual domiciled in China, or not domiciled but resident in China for 183 days or more within a tax year, is a resident individual and is taxed on income from within China or overseas. An individual resident for fewer than 183 days is a non-resident individual, taxed on China-source income only. A tax year runs 1 January to 31 December.
rules.value: 183 days in a tax year
rules.authority: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 amendment)

rules.topic: Chinese individual income tax rates
rules.finding: Comprehensive income (salary and wages, remuneration for personal services, author's remuneration, royalties) is taxed at progressive rates of 3 percent to 45 percent. Income from interest, dividends or bonuses, leasing of assets, transfer of assets, and incidental income is taxed at a flat rate of 20 percent.
rules.value: 3%–45% progressive; 20% flat on interest, dividends, property transfer
rules.authority: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 amendment)

rules.topic: Chinese individual income tax standard deduction
rules.finding: For comprehensive income received by a resident individual, taxable income is the balance after deduction of RMB 60,000, special deductions, itemized deductions for specific expenditures, and other deductible items determined pursuant to law.
rules.value: RMB 60,000 per tax year
rules.authority: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 amendment)

rules.topic: Virtual currency as an exit channel
rules.finding: All virtual-currency-related business activities are illegal and shall be strictly prohibited and cracked down upon in accordance with the law. It is an illegal financial activity for overseas virtual-currency exchanges to provide services for domestic residents via the internet. Financial institutions and non-bank payment institutions are banned from offering services for such activity.
rules.value: Prohibited
rules.authority: PBOC and nine other government departments, September 2021 joint notice

rules.topic: Chinese customs thresholds for carrying cash out of the country
rules.finding: Frequently quoted thresholds for RMB cash and foreign-currency cash carried across the Chinese border could NOT be confirmed against an official Chinese customs source in this session. They are deliberately not stated here.
rules.value: unverified

rules.topic: Chinese corporate income tax rate on company profits
rules.finding: The rate applicable to a Chinese company's profits before a dividend distribution was not confirmed against an official source in this session and is therefore not stated.
rules.value: unverified

rules.topic: Chinese domestic withholding rate absent a treaty claim
rules.finding: The domestic Chinese withholding rate that would apply to dividends, interest or royalties without a treaty claim was not confirmed against an official source in this session and is therefore not stated. Only the treaty cap of 10% is stated, from the treaty text itself.
rules.value: unverified
